title: The first letter, v
logline: Friday. A second letter, a follow-up, higher figure. Wood reads the number, folds it, and puts it under the same leg. The table is now too high on that side.

panels.composition: The garage. A second envelope, same logo (drawn blank). WOOD opening it. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man opening a second letter with a blank logo shape on the envelope in a garage studio, a small dog watching

panels.composition: The figure. Drawn as a number with too many zeros to fit the panel; the last zero cut off by the border.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a letter where a dollar figure runs off the edge of the panel with its last zero cut by the border
image.notes: The number is never legible; the zeros leave the panel.

panels.composition: Wood folding it. Kneeling. Sliding it under the same leg, on top of the first.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man kneeling to slide a second folded letter under a drafting table's leg on top of the first, no words

panels.composition: The table now too high on that side. The coffee sliding the other way. Wood looking at it. The dog looking at him. The chorus at the back, all signs reading NO now, upside down.
props: the table, tilted the other way

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a drafting table now tilted too high on one side with a coffee mug sliding, a man looking at it and a dog looking at him, stick figures at the back holding signs upside down

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The second letter over-shims the table. 'Hm.'
